title: Repair the dispatch spawn line for herdr 0.8.0 (split-then-start)
action: REWORK after a NEEDS_REVISION judge verdict on commit dbd081b3. The bulk of the cell is already correct and committed — do NOT redo it. Read the current skills/bee-herding/references/role-dispatch.md and fix exactly the two defects below, then re-run the regen chain (bee dev regen: render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order) so all five mirrors carry the fix. DEFECT ONE (judge check X1): the document's own convention is that a section-sign reference means a numbered SECTION of the role — it is used that way at roughly fourteen sites, including one four lines away from the defect. The rewrite introduced two references that use the same notation to mean a numbered STEP inside section 8: at the hit 'On any `agent start` failure, close the pane §2 just created' and at the hit 'shows exactly **one** new pane — the one §2 split —'. A cold control agent following the document's convention resolves those to section 2, which is the gate-bypass refusal and has nothing to do with panes. Reword both so they unambiguously name the step, not a section — for example 'the pane step 2 of this section just created'. While there, tighten the nearby phrase 'apply this step's cleanup rule', which names no step at all and sits several paragraphs after step 3 opens. Do not change the notation anywhere it correctly means a section. DEFECT TWO (part of judge check T2): near the top of step 2 the text forward-claims 'this inverts the earlier proof; re-recorded live in `references/spawn-proof.md`'. That claim is false right now — spawn-proof.md still documents the OLD single-command form and still tells the reader not to split first. Reword to state the inversion as a fact about herdr 0.8.0 without asserting that the proof document has already been re-recorded. SCOPE LIMIT, read carefully: skills/bee-herding/references/spawn-proof.md is cell ho-2's file and is NOT yours. Do not open it for writing, do not edit it, and do not treat its stale content as your defect — the rest of judge check T2 belongs to ho-2 and the must_have below has been rescoped accordingly.

No herdr agent start invocation in role-dispatch.md or operational-invariants.md carries --cwd, --workspace, --tab, --split or --no-focus. (spawn-proof.md is cell ho-2's scope, not this cell's.)
A failed agent start closes the pane step 2 just created, before reporting.
herding.agent_command keeps its documented array shape; token 0 supplies --kind and the remainder follows the -- separator.

Every section-sign reference in role-dispatch.md means a numbered section of the role, never a numbered step inside a section.
role-dispatch.md makes no claim that spawn-proof.md has already been re-recorded.
